claim_label: Two Branches of Philosophy of Technology
description: Philosophical reflection on technology has historically been divided between 'humanities philosophy of technology' (focusing on societal impact) and 'analytic philosophy of technology' (focusing on the practice of engineering and design).

instances.assertion: Philosophical reflection on technology has historically been divided between 'humanities philosophy of technology' (focusing on societal impact) and 'analytic philosophy of technology' (focusing on the practice of engineering and design).

The philosophy of technology has historically been divided into two main branches: a 'humanities' approach focused on societal impact and an 'analytic' approach focused on the nature of design and artifacts.
The 'humanities philosophy of technology' tradition focuses on the socio-cultural impact of technology, while 'analytic philosophy of technology' focuses on the practice of engineering and design.
